entities.name: Bobby Capó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félix Manuel "Bobby" Rodríguez Capó was a Puerto Rican singer and songwriter. He usually combined ballads with classical music and was deeply involved in Puerto Rican folk elements and even Andalusian music, as to produce many memorable Latino pop songs which featured elaborate, dramatic lyrics.

entities.name: Bobby Capó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Félix Manuel "Bobby" Rodríguez Capó was a Puerto Rican singer and songwriter. He usually combined ballads with classical music and was deeply involved in Puerto Rican folk elements and even Andalusian music, as to produce many memorable Latino pop songs which featured elaborate, dramatic lyrics.
